1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 b6 4.Bg2.strategy: Brings the bishop out and clears the way to castling. It sits behind its own knight for now, but will press down the long diagonal as soon as the knight moves.

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 b6 4.Bg2 Bb7.strategy: Puts the bishop on the long diagonal, where it defends the d5-pawn, so Black can meet pressure on the centre with pieces. The d5-pawn blocks the bishop for now, which keeps Black's game a little passive.
